Figure1.conclusion: TrustDive combines bounded latent calibration with exact reference-conditioned phase evidence.

Figure2.conclusion: Under a shared frozen-feature protocol, TrustDive yields the lowest absolute error while TSA-style yields the highest rank correlation.

Figure3.conclusion: Enlarged real query phases and matched training references make the score decomposition inspectable in a typical and a high-disagreement performance.

Figure4.conclusion: Across 735 reference-supported videos, the highest attributed phase usually matches and exceeds the phase with the largest direct intervention effect.

Figure5.conclusion: Phase evidence is informative but only moderately stable to boundary and reference changes.
